text: Before the takeoff roll is started, the auto brake system of the aircraft, if available, is set to the RTO mode. The auto brake system will automatically apply maximum brakes if throttle is reduced to idle or reverse thrust during the takeoff roll below V1. What will the auto brake system be set to before takeoff?
